integrity: All 1,911 five-point supports are enumerated with standalone exact binary-field computations; two implementations independently reproduce the seven orbit representatives and semilinear partition. External independent audit has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: The census is exact for one binary BCH code at length 273 only; it does not derive an infinite-family weight distribution. The previous parameters [273,249,5] are not new. Possible implicit coverage in older weight enumerator literature remains a priority risk.
title: Seven cyclic classes of minimum words in the binary length-273 BCH code
